remarks: **Quality-built Artisan Ranch in the desirable Lake View area of Hamburg!** This beautifully crafted home offers 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, including a private primary suite featuring a custom tile shower and an 8' x 8' walk-in closet. The open-concept floor plan seamlessly connects the great room, dining area, and kitchen, creating an ideal space for everyday living and entertaining. The builder is offering a **$5,500 credit** for the buyer to select their own kitchen countertops, allowing you to personalize the space to your taste.The great room features an elegant tray ceiling, while the convenient first-floor laundry adds to the home's functionality. The full basement boasts 8-foot poured walls and a 4' x 4' egress window, providing excellent potential for future finishing. Additional features include a high-efficiency furnace, central air conditioning, and a finished, painted attached two-car garage.Outside, enjoy the concrete driveway and sidewalks, all situated on a generous **90' x 236' lot** directly across from the Lake View playground, offering tennis courts, baseball fields, swing sets, and open green space.**Exceptional craftsmanship, quality finishes, and an outstanding location make this new construction home a tremendous value!**
